comment: Iteration B / B3: normative adopter-contract promises mapped to behavioral evidence. GAP-1's root cause was a documented AC (mageqa AC-7) with NO observing test. Every numbered AC in every consumer handoff is classified here: engine-enforceable rows name the algebra rows, VERIFIED engine tests, sealed oracle rows, and mutation evidence that observe the promise; consumer-repo-obligation rows carry an explicit waiver naming who proves them and what engine mechanics support them. The guard (test_contract_guards.py::test_adopter_promises_map_to_evidence) parses the real docs: a NEW AC without a registry row fails by doc+number, a reworded anchor fails by doc+anchor, and dangling test/oracle/algebra references fail by name. The guard checks EXISTENCE of the referenced evidence, not its semantics — the semantic proof lives in the named tests and mutation kills themselves.
